Finding Foxhand useful?

Please recommend it to anyone you think would find it useful too. Word of mouth helps others discover the extension.

If you have a moment, here are a few other ways to help:

  • Leave an honest review on AMOTell us about your experience.
  • Star Foxhand on GitHubSupport the project.
  • Share a suggestion or report an issueTell us what we can improve.

Thanks for using Foxhand!
